venture.name: Table Time
venture.concept: Campus dining information app purchased by universities and provided to students.
venture.primary_product: Dining hall crowd levels, estimated waits and table availability, with administrator traffic insights.
venture.target_customers: University administrators and campus dining managers; undergraduate users typically aged 18–24.
venture.value_proposition: Help students avoid delays and find space to eat together; help dining teams plan staffing and seating.
venture.geographic_market: North American colleges and universities; Fairfield University and the Tully are the initial use case.
venture.distribution_channels: Institutional purchase and student app access are stated in the workspace. Direct university sales and campus promotion are proposed channels, not confirmed agreements.
features: Quieter times and alternative dining locations
venture.source: Ella Alberta.pdf, entire seven-page document reviewed; venture details on pages 1–3.
unknowns: Number of halls and students per contract
assumptions: A single-hall software-only pilot is used for the preliminary recommendation.
Existing reliable occupancy and queue data would be supplied or integrated; new sensing hardware is outside that pilot range.

competitors.name: Occuspace / Waitz
competitors.target_customers: University facilities and dining administrators; student users
competitors.positioning: Institutional occupancy specialist; price tier unknown
competitors.inclusion_reason: Closest match: UCLA dining deployment links student crowd information with administrator operations.

competitors.name: Waitwhile
competitors.geographic_market: US education and broader international service markets
competitors.target_customers: Campus service teams and organizations managing queues
competitors.positioning: Scalable queue software; mid-range within this selected paid sample
competitors.inclusion_reason: Competes for the university waiting-time problem, but campus dining occupancy and group-seat detection are not established by the reviewed pages.

competitors.name: Waitlist Me
competitors.geographic_market: US and Canada pricing; international availability
competitors.positioning: Budget option within this selected paid sample
competitors.inclusion_reason: A dining operator could manage waits and tables with this tool; it does not establish automatic dining hall sensing.

competitors.name: TablesReady
competitors.geographic_market: US and Canada plans; international message allowances differ
competitors.positioning: Higher-priced representative within this selected queue sample
competitors.inclusion_reason: Restaurant seating and wait tools address parts of Table Time’s problem, though a staffed waitlist differs from self-service campus dining.

comparison.cohort: Paid representative indirect queue-software plans, annual billing, monthly equivalents; starting configurations, not equal capacity
comparison.excluded_reason: Occuspace price unavailable; free, alternate tiers and monthly-billed duplicates excluded.

preliminary_pricing_recommendation.scope: Software-only single-hall pilot with reliable existing data, student access and basic administrator insights.
preliminary_pricing_recommendation.exclusions: New sensors, installation, custom integrations and exceptional messaging/support must be scoped separately.
preliminary_pricing_recommendation.rationale: Near the upper portion of the $47.99–$79 annual-billing queue-software representative range, with a modest premium only if separate entry/food waits and usable group-seat information are demonstrated. Occuspace is the key feature benchmark but cannot anchor a price without a quote.
preliminary_pricing_recommendation.next_steps: Obtain matched vendor quotes; define data collection; validate costs, break-even, demand, accuracy and willingness to pay before setting a final price.

research_limitations: Only four purposively selected competitors; this is not a census or market-average estimate.
Occuspace is the closest direct match, but no public institutional price was established.
Queue software is an indirect substitute. No comparable full campus occupancy deployment price sample exists.
Starting rates have different usage allowances and features. Normalization aligns billing time, not capacity or outcomes.
Waitwhile and TablesReady monthly-billing prices and all paid volume configurations were not captured. No missing rates were inferred from advertised discounts.
Taxes, deployment, devices, integrations, support and messaging may add cost; no vendor quotes or checkout transactions were obtained.
Prices are a public-page snapshot checked October 27, 2026, and can change.
Table Time’s costs, technology, demand and university willingness to pay remain untested.
Competitor feature descriptions are vendor claims, not independently tested performance. The source PDF’s Reddit findings were not revalidated in this mission.

verification_definitions.Verified: Observed on an official page or authoritative primary source.
verification_definitions.Partially Verified: Only retailer/search evidence; not fully confirmed on product page.
verification_definitions.Estimated: Explicit analytical estimate, not an observed price.

price_semantics: Null means unknown or not applicable, never zero. Regular means current standard advertised price, not proven historical transaction price. Annual totals for monthly-displayed annual plans are calculated as rate times 12. No temporary promotional prices were observed.
